### What does this PR do?

Allows S3 bucket usage for uploading and downloading FSDP checkpoints

### Checklist Before Starting

- [ X ] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/volcengine/verl/pulls?q=s3 (past closed one was from me as well)
- [ X ] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)
  - `{modules}` include `fsdp`, `megatron`, `sglang`, `vllm`, `rollout`, `trainer`, `ci`, `training_utils`, `recipe`, `hardware`, `deployment`, `ray`, `worker`, `single_controller`, `misc`, `perf`, `model`, `algo`, `env`, `tool`, `ckpt`, `doc`, `data`
  - If this PR involves multiple modules, separate them with `,` like `[megatron, fsdp, doc]`
  - `{type}` is in `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `chore`, `test`
  - If this PR breaks any API (CLI arguments, config, function signature, etc.), add `[BREAKING]` to the beginning of the title.
  - Example: `[BREAKING][fsdp, megatron] feat: dynamic batching`

### Test

Added unit test to mock s3 uploading.

### API and Usage Example

To resume from s3 and automatically use latest checkpoint in s3 put: 
trainer.resume_mode=auto
trainer.resume_from_path=s3://<bucket_name>/<path>

To resume from s3 at a specific step put:
trainer.resume_mode=resume_path
trainer.resume_from_path=s3://<bucket_name>/<path>/<step_folder>

To save to s3 bucket put: trainer.s3_checkpoint_dir=s3://<bucket_name>/<path>

Ensure that your local aws configuration is set to the correct region before running, you will also need to pip install boto3.

### Specific Changes

Add in S3 upload/download utility functions to verl/utils/s3_io.py
Change ray_trainer to resume from s3 checkpoint if an s3 path provided in trainer.resume_mode.
Change ray_trainer to save to s3 bucket if bucket is set in s3_checkpoint_dir
Change copy_to_local to accept S3 in addition to HDFS
Change hdfs_path to remote_path to accept s3 checkpoints
Implement auto resume from latest s3 checkpoint

This is likely to become a concern when the training job size gets large. We may need to do a more dedicate S3 prefix planning for those large training jobs.

### What does this PR do?

Allows S3 bucket usage for uploading and downloading FSDP checkpoints

### Checklist Before Starting

- [ X ] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/volcengine/verl/pulls?q=s3 (past closed one was from me as well)
- [ X ] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)
  - `{modules}` include `fsdp`, `megatron`, `sglang`, `vllm`, `rollout`, `trainer`, `ci`, `training_utils`, `recipe`, `hardware`, `deployment`, `ray`, `worker`, `single_controller`, `misc`, `perf`, `model`, `algo`, `env`, `tool`, `ckpt`, `doc`, `data`

  - If this PR breaks any API (CLI arguments, config, function signature, etc.), add `[BREAKING]` to the beginning of the title.
  - Example: `[BREAKING][fsdp, megatron] feat: dynamic batching`

### Test

Added unit test to mock s3 uploading.

### API and Usage Example

To resume from s3 and automatically use latest checkpoint in s3 put: 
trainer.resume_mode=auto
trainer.resume_from_path=s3://<bucket_name>/<path>

To resume from s3 at a specific step put:
trainer.resume_mode=resume_path
trainer.resume_from_path=s3://<bucket_name>/<path>/<step_folder>

To save to s3 bucket put: trainer.s3_checkpoint_dir=s3://<bucket_name>/<path>

Ensure that your local aws configuration is set to the correct region before running, you will also need to pip install boto3.

### Specific Changes

Add in S3 upload/download utility functions to verl/utils/s3_io.py
Change ray_trainer to resume from s3 checkpoint if an s3 path provided in trainer.resume_mode.
Change ray_trainer to save to s3 bucket if bucket is set in s3_checkpoint_dir
Change copy_to_local to accept S3 in addition to HDFS
Change hdfs_path to remote_path to accept s3 checkpoints
Implement auto resume from latest s3 checkpoint

+

+

+    torch.distributed.destroy_process_group()
+

+    test_fsdp_s3_ckpt(strategy=strategy)
